poses.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet on a genuinely transparent background. Reference image is the existing WALK animation and is the strict identity, proportions and pixel rendering master. Create SIX full-body dialogue standing poses in an exact 3 columns x 2 rows grid on a 1536x1024 canvas (each cell 512x512). Same character in every cell, same head size, hair volume, body proportions, costume, boots, pixel density, crisp outlines and lighting as reference. All look three-quarter toward screen right. Maintain the walking reference's slender body and legs; DO NOT make a squat or larger-headed chibi. Boots level at the same baseline in each cell, hair crown same height, all raised hands BELOW the crown. Full figure centered in each cell with generous transparent gutters. No scenery, ground shadow, text, labels, gridlines, extra objects or weapons. Do not alter the outfit. Pose changes must affect arms and expressive face, not stature. Sprite hair crown to boots approximately 430 pixels per cell. Aria, elf girl with blonde hair, single pale lavender forelock, green eyes, white flower and green leaves in hair, forest green cape, brown corset, white ruffled tunic/skirt and brown lace-up boots. Row 1 left: relaxed neutral attentive standing, hands down, eyes open. Row 1 middle: warm eyes-closed smile, one hand raised next to head in greeting, hold this hand pose. Row 1 right: surprised wide eyes, small open mouth, hands drawn close to chest. Row 2 left: playful inquisitive expression, slight head tilt, one hand at chin, same height. Row 2 middle: cheerful open-palm offering gesture toward right, friendly open-eyed smile. Row 2 right: attractive mischievous confident grin, one hand on hip, other index finger lifted at shoulder height; friendly teasing childhood friend, not angry or sinister.
